text:
This tutorial shows how to add a staff
member. Everything you see uses fictional

On the Users page, select New staff. You
can also choose Add Staff from your

Step one covers personal and employment
details: the name, job role, employment

Step two holds the contact details. The
invitation is sent to this email address.
Step three records an emergency contact.

Step four sets availability: working days,
preferred shift times, and the maximum

Select Create. Crewflow creates the staff
record and queues an invitation email.

The new staff member's details open. Their
status shows the invitation until they
accept it and sign in to the mobile app.
